notes: The user confirmed Block A as the north bar and Block B as the south body on 2026-11-07; recorded by Claude in level-zones.md @b36d328. Identity confirmation does not certify every height, room or accessibility condition.

Sheet level values and local level zones remain documented/derived from their sources. Identity confirmation does not make one datum valid throughout a floor. The historical C2 profile remains a flat slab at scene elevation 3.5 m.
Block B ground-floor clinic also contains N -4.13; first-floor ramps have intermediate levels. A single floor datum does not describe every point.
Plan (x,y) maps to scene (x,elevation,-y). Plan +Y is not geographic north. Survey datums must be reconciled with each exported model before navigation is enabled.
